2608.02104.title: Uncertainty-Aware Crossmodal Fusion for Classification of Animal Behavior
2608.02104.paper_summary: Artificial intelligence offers substantial potential for acoustic monitoring of animals, from welfare assessment in precision livestock farming to wildlife conservation and ecological research, where vocalizations can indicate health, stress, and social states earlier and at lower cost than manual observation. However, recordings in these settings are obtained under uncontrolled conditions, including environmental noise, reverberation, overlapping calls, and sensors that degrade without notice. As a consequence, automated classification of animal vocalizations remains challenging, and the two dominant acoustic representations show complementary limitations: raw waveforms preserve temporal microstructure but degrade under clipping and reverberation, while log-Mel spectrograms capture harmonic organization but lose phase information and are sensitive to broadband noise. To address these challenges, we propose Uncertainty-Aware Fusion (UAF), a dual-stream framework that estimates Gaussian uncertainty for each representation and fuses them via uncertainty weighting. This mechanism assigns greater weight to the more confident representation with no reliability labels required. In a cross-species, identity-based evaluation excluding all individuals seen during training, UAF (mean pooling) achieves 59.4\% accuracy / 39.7\% macro F1 on the 17-class SoundWel pig vocalization benchmark and 73.1\% accuracy / 71.5\% macro F1 on the 3-class DogBark dataset, outperforming static-concatenation fusion by 15.7\% and 20.4\% relative macro F1, respectively. Ablations over four temporal aggregation strategies show that uncertainty fusion, rather than the temporal characteristics of animal calls, is the primary driver of the performance gain.
2608.02104.paper_summary_zh: 人工智慧為動物的聲學監測提供了相當大的潛力，從精準畜牧業中的福利評估到野生動物保護和生態研究，在這些領域中，動物的聲音可以更早且以較低的成本指示健康、壓力和社會狀態，而不需要手動觀察。<lb/>然而，在這些環境中獲得的錄音是在不受控制的條件下進行的，包括環境噪音、混響、重疊的叫聲以及無預警劣化的傳感器。<lb/>因此，自動化的動物聲音分類仍然具有挑戰性，而兩種主要的聲學表示法各自存在互補的限制：原始波形保留了時間微結構，但在削波和混響下會劣化，而對數梅爾頻譜圖捕捉了和諧結構，但失去了相位信息，並對寬頻噪音敏感。<lb/>為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了不確定性感知融合（UAF），這是一個雙流框架，為每種表示法估計高斯不確定性並通過不確定性加權進行融合。<lb/>這一機制為更有信心的表示法分配更大的權重，且不需要可靠性標籤。<lb/>在一項跨物種的基於身份的評估中，排除了所有在訓練期間見過的個體，UAF（均值池化）在17類SoundWel豬叫聲基準上達到59.4%的準確率/39.7%的宏觀F1，並在3類DogBark數據集上達到73.1%的準確率/71.5%的宏觀F1，相對於靜態拼接融合分別提高了15.7%和20.4%的宏觀F1。<lb/>對四種時間聚合策略的消融實驗顯示，不確定性融合，而不是動物叫聲的時間特徵，是性能提升的主要驅動因素。
